title: Emerging Pharmacotherapeutic Strategies to Overcome Undruggable Proteins in Cancer.
authors: Lu, Yuqing; Yang, Yuewen; Zhu, Guanghao; Zeng, Hairong; Fan, Yiming; Guo, Fujia; Xu, Dongshu; Wang, Boya; Chen, Dapeng; Ge, Guangbo
one_liner_zh: 综述癌症中不可成药靶点（如KRAS、TP53）的克服策略，涵盖靶向蛋白-DNA结合及AlphaFold等AI辅助技术，但非聚焦TF-DNA互作建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Targeted therapies in cancer treatment can improve in vivo efficacy and reduce adverse effects by altering the tissue exposure of specific biomolecules. However, there are still large number of target proteins in cancer are still undruggable, owing to the following factors including (1) lack of ligand-binding pockets, (2) function based on protein-protein interactions (PPIs), (3) the highly specific conserved active sites among protein family members, and (4) the variability of tertiary docking structures. The current status of undruggable targets proteins such as KRAS, TP53, C-MYC, PTP, are carefully introduced in this review. Some novel techniques and drug designing strategies have been applicated for overcoming these undruggable proteins, and the most classic and well-known technology is proteolysis targeting chimeras (PROTACs). In this review, the novel drug development strategies including targeting protein degradation, targeting PPI, targeting intrinsically disordered regions, as well as targeting protein-DNA binding are described, and we also discuss the potential of these strategies for overcoming the undruggable targets. Besides, intelligence-assisted technologies like Alpha-Fold help us a lot to predict the protein structure, which is beneficial for drug development. The discovery of new targets and the development of drugs targeting them, especially those undruggable targets, remain a huge challenge. New drug development strategies, better extraction processes that do not disrupt protein-protein interactions, and more precise artificial intelligence technologies may provide significant assistance in overcoming these undruggable targets.
abstract_zh: 癌症治疗中的靶向疗法可通过改变特定生物分子的组织暴露来提高体内疗效并减少不良反应。然而，癌症中仍有大量靶蛋白因以下因素而不可成药，包括：（1）缺乏配体结合口袋，（2）功能基于蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs），（3）蛋白家族成员间高度特异的保守活性位点，以及（4）三级对接结构的变异性。本综述详细介绍了不可成药靶蛋白（如KRAS、TP53、C-MYC、PTP）的现状。一些新技术和药物设计策略已被应用于克服这些不可成药蛋白，其中最经典且广为人知的技术是蛋白水解靶向嵌合体（PROTACs）。本综述描述了新型药物开发策略，包括靶向蛋白降解、靶向PPI、靶向内在无序区域以及靶向蛋白质-DNA结合，并讨论了这些策略在克服不可成药靶点方面的潜力。此外，像Alpha-Fold这样的智能辅助技术极大地帮助我们预测蛋白质结构，这对药物开发有益。新靶点的发现及针对这些靶点（尤其是不可成药靶点）的药物开发仍是一个巨大挑战。新的药物开发策略、不破坏蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的更好提取工艺，以及更精确的人工智能技术，可能为克服这些不可成药靶点提供重要帮助。
